messages.text:
"Recreate Clash Mini, but with your own characters. Selectively choose your own abilities and combos with other characters, just like in Clash Mini. Each player will have their own hero and troops. There are a total of 6 heroes, including the hero. Each hero will have a passive ability and an ultimate-style ability that will activate according to its corresponding type. The types can be Tanks, who charge their ultimate by either dealing damage or receiving damage slowly; Assassins, who charge their ultimate by dealing damage quite quickly; and Healers, who charge their ultimate healing allys. These in turn are divided into other subtypes such as Wizard for example and some at your disposal.
https://android-create.omgithub.com/joaquinbenia07-bot/PlayGround/issues/5

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
